note: Structured cross-provider Free LLM API policy database. Distinguishes permanently free, credit-unlocked free tiers, and time-limited free trials. Never claim verified when stale or unverified.

providers.name: OpenRouter (:free)
providers.credit_card_note: No card required for 50 RPD. Higher 1,000 RPD tier requires >=$10 lifetime credit purchase (triggers at $9 credited balance to buffer top-up fees and rounding).
providers.quota_summary: 20 RPM global; 50 RPD (<$9/$10 lifetime credits) or 1,000 RPD (>=$9/$10 credits); upstream capacity may still return HTTP 429
providers.privacy_policy: Depends on upstream host; account-level privacy setting can opt out of training and block providers that train.

model_quotas.unlock_rule: $10 lifetime purchase ($9 net credit threshold buffer)

providers.name: Google Gemini API (AI Studio)
providers.credit_card_note: No credit card required. Linking a Google Cloud Billing account automatically switches the project to Paid Tier.
providers.quota_summary: Per-project RPM / TPM / RPD limits vary dynamically by model (check Google AI Studio Rate Limits console).
providers.privacy_policy: Free tier prompts and outputs may be reviewed by human annotators and used to improve Google products (Paid tier opts out).

model_quotas.model: Gemini Flash / Pro free-tier models (dynamic per project)
model_quotas.note: Exact numeric limits vary by model and project; verify live values in AI Studio console.

providers.name: Groq (Free Plan)
providers.credit_card_note: No credit card required; standing free tier (no trial clock). Upgrading to Developer pay-as-you-go requires a card.
providers.quota_summary: Org-level, model-specific caps. Verified for GPT-OSS 120B, GPT-OSS 20B, and Qwen 3.8 27B: 30 RPM, 1,000 RPD, 8,000 TPM, 200,000 TPD.
providers.reset_cycle: Per-minute & daily rolling limits (see Groq Console > Limits)
providers.privacy_policy: No training on customer inputs/outputs (Free & Paid); zero inference retention by default (up to 30-day abuse/reliability logs).

providers.name: Cloudflare Workers AI
providers.credit_card_note: No credit card required on Workers Free plan for eligible open-weights models. Larger frontier models or overage ($0.011 / 1k Neurons) require Workers Paid ($5/mo).
providers.quota_summary: 10,000 Neurons/day free (resets 00:00 UTC). Example: @cf/meta/llama-3.2-1b-instruct uses 2,457 Neurons/1M input & 18,252 Neurons/1M output (~863 calls/day at 1,000 in / 500 out).
providers.privacy_policy: Inputs/outputs are not used to train models or shared with third-party model providers.

providers.name: Cerebras Inference
providers.credit_card_note: Verified payment method required to activate API & Playground access (no upfront charge; no permanently free tier).
providers.quota_summary: One-time $5 trial credit valid for 30 days only (no auto-renewing free tier). Shared Free Trial caps include 5 RPM, 30,000 uncached input TPM, 90,000 total TPM, up to 1M tokens/hour or day (model-dependent).
providers.reset_cycle: Does NOT renew — $5 trial expires after 30 days
providers.privacy_policy: Consult official Cerebras Inference Docs / Terms for current trial-tier data retention & training policy.

model_quotas.note: Expires after $5 credit or 30 days; requires verified payment method.

policy_history.summary: Reclassified from permanently free to Time-Limited Free Trial: official docs confirm new accounts require a verified payment method to unlock $5 trial credits valid for 30 days, with no permanently free auto-renewing tier (shared trial caps include 5 RPM, 30k uncached input TPM).
Documented OpenRouter's $9 credited-balance buffer for the $10 lifetime purchase threshold unlocking 1,000 RPD (accounts for top-up fees and rounding); 20 RPM global cap unchanged.

Added official Neuron pricing for @cf/meta/llama-3.2-1b-instruct (2,457 Neurons / 1M input, 18,252 Neurons / 1M output) against the 10,000 Neurons/day free allowance (~863 calls/day at 1,000 in / 500 out).
